chunks: And Abu Ja'far al-Baqir عليه السلام said:
"Touching the deceased at the time of his death and after his ghusl, and kissing him, there is no harm in it."
ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to touch or kiss a deceased person in Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith states that touching the deceased at the time of death, after the deceased has been given ghusl, and kissing the deceased are not problematic. It serves as a jurisprudential clarification concerning permissible conduct with the dead.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.400 - Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) said:
"Touching a deceased person at the time of their death and after their washing, and kissing them, is not an issue”.
